facts.text: Farmhouse Inn is a hideaway in Sonoma's Russian River Valley.
facts.excerpt: A 25-room hideaway in Sonoma’s Russian River Valley

facts.text: The inn is set on six quiet acres between vineyards, redwoods and the coast.
facts.excerpt: Set on six quiet acres between vineyards, redwoods, and the coast

facts.text: The inn feels more like a private country home than a hotel.
facts.excerpt: Farmhouse Inn feels more like a private country home than a hotel

facts.text: The inn can drive guests around Sonoma in one of its fleet of electric Volvos.
facts.excerpt: even drive you in one of our fleet of electric Volvos

facts.text: The Barn One Bedroom Suite, tucked furthest back on the property, has a separate sitting room and a wide patio warmed by a dual fireplace.
facts.excerpt: Tucked furthest back on the property, the Barn One Bedroom Suite offers maximum privacy with a separate sitting room and a wide patio warmed by a dual fireplace.

facts.text: The Barn Junior Suite has floor-to-ceiling windows, an indoor and outdoor fireplace, a steam shower, heated marble floors and a two-person tub.
facts.excerpt: Floor-to-ceiling windows bring the trees close in our Barn Junior Suite, where an indoor and outdoor fireplace anchors the space from day to night. A spa-style bath adds steam shower, heated marble floors, and a two-person tub.

facts.text: Cottages have private entrances and outdoor seating, plus a gas fireplace, steam shower, heated marble floors and deep soaking tub.
facts.excerpt: Cottages keep the experience intimate, with private entrances and outdoor seating that makes it easy to slip into the garden air. Inside, a romantic gas fireplace, steam shower, heated marble floors, and deep soaking tub

facts.text: The Wellness Barn spa brings together bodywork, seasonal rituals and thoughtful sourcing.
facts.excerpt: The Wellness Barn brings together bodywork, seasonal rituals, thoughtful sourcing, and the natural calm of the property

facts.text: Many Wellness Barn treatments spotlight locally grown and sourced ingredients, and the menu includes a CBD and gem stone bathing ritual.
facts.excerpt: many of the treatments spotlighting locally grown and sourced ingredients. The spa menu includes the expected massages and facials as well as more surprising options, like a CBD and gem stone bathing ritual.

facts.text: Fitness options include a walking path beneath the trees, a Peloton bike and free weights, and private sessions the team can arrange.
facts.excerpt: hike our path beneath the trees, energize the body with a Peloton Ride and free weights, or let our team help arrange a private session

facts.text: The Restaurant serves season-driven farm-to-table cuisine for breakfast, lunch and dinner, and in-room dining is available.
facts.excerpt: The Restaurant delivers season-driven farm-to-table cuisine, for breakfast, lunch, and dinner. Add in-room dining when privacy calls

facts.text: Farmhouse Inn was founded in 2001 by brother and sister Joe and Catherine Bartolomei, fifth-generation Sonomans whose family farm is nearby.
facts.excerpt: It was founded in 2001 by brother and sister Joe and Catherine Bartolomei, fifth-generation Sonomans whose family farm is nearby.

facts.text: Foley Entertainment Group purchased the majority share of Farmhouse Inn in September 2023.
facts.excerpt: In September 2023, Foley Entertainment Group (established by businessman and vintner Bill Foley with other luxe hospitality ventures like Santa Barbara’s Hotel Californian under its aegis) purchased the majority share of Farmhouse Inn.

facts.text: The property has a small swimming pool and gardens with roses in late spring and early summer.
facts.excerpt: a charming little swimming pool, and the most beautiful gardens, especially if you come in late spring or early summer when the roses are going off

facts.text: There is croquet and nightly s'mores.
facts.excerpt: croquet and nightly s’mores

facts.text: The inn is about 15 minutes from Healdsburg.
facts.excerpt: It’s about 15 minutes from both Healdsburg

facts.text: Armstrong Redwoods State Natural Reserve is about a 10-mile drive from the property.
facts.excerpt: Armstrong Redwoods, a state natural reserve, with its giant trees and miles of hiking trails is about a 10-mile drive from property.

facts.text: The inn has close relationships with dozens of nearby vineyards, and the concierge can help arrange special tours and tastings.
facts.excerpt: The Farmhouse Inn has dozens of very close relationships with nearby vineyards and the concierge can help arrange special tours and tastings.

facts.text: Kitchen waste goes to the hotel's hens, which lay all of the eggs for the property.
facts.excerpt: kitchen waste goes to hotels 80-some hens, who in turn lay all of the eggs for the property

facts.text: Many of the Restaurant's ingredients are grown on the Bartolomei family farm.
facts.excerpt: hyper local ingredients (many of them grown on the Bartolomei family farm)

facts.text: Farmhouse Inn hosts weddings and celebrations for up to fifty guests.
facts.excerpt: Farmhouse Inn hosts weddings and celebrations for up to fifty guests

facts.text: The hotel has ADA-compliant rooms.
facts.excerpt: The hotel has ADA-compliant rooms

facts.text: The Restaurant is dinner-only, open Thursday through Monday, with an ever-evolving chef's tasting menu.
facts.excerpt: is dinner-only and is open Thursday through Monday. It offers an ever-evolving chef’s tasting menu

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler Readers' Choice Awards 2017-2026 and Gold List.

contradictions.note: p1 says the Restaurant serves breakfast, lunch and dinner; p3 says it is dinner-only Thursday-Monday (with the casual Farmstand for other meals)
